subject: Convert accelerator voucher to prepaid invoice — invoicing & promo split
messages:
From: Nora Patel <nora@orchidai.co>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Request to convert accelerator voucher to prepaid invoice

Hi Priyom,

Orchid AI just wrapped the accelerator program and we have a $15,000 Redwood voucher on the program ledger. Our finance team prefers a prepaid invoice rather than an internal voucher for bookkeeping and tax treatment. Two quick questions:

1) Can Redwood convert that voucher value into a prepaid invoice we can pay (we'd issue a PO)?
2) If yes, can any promotional portion of the voucher (we were given a 20% onboarding promo) be split between hosted API credits and a reserved/dedicated credit line?

We need the paperwork before our board meeting on Aug 4; onboarding planned week of Aug 10. Happy to provide PO and billing details.

Thanks —
Nora
Nora Patel
Head of Ops, Orchid AI
Nora@orchidai.co
(Attachment: Accelerator_voucher-orn.pdf stub)

From: Priyom Das <pri.yom@redwood.com>
To: Nora Patel <nora@orchidai.co>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to convert accelerator voucher to prepaid invoice

Hi Nora — thanks for the note and congrats on finishing the accelerator. Short answers up-front: we can usually convert vouchers to an invoiced prepay in edge cases, but it requires approval from finance and (sometimes) legal. The promo split is trickier because promotions are typically tied to hosted credits only.

Proposed next steps:
- Can you share the PO/billing company name and the voucher certificate?
- I'll loop in finance (Ben) and customer success (Lauren) to confirm accounting treatment and whether we can make an exception for a split to reserved capacity.
- If finance signs off, we will generate a prepaid invoice at voucher face value less any negotiated concession and mark the invoice as "prepaid credits" on our books.

Cc'ing Lauren for onboarding timing and Ben for invoice/PO guidance. I expect a response from finance in 48–72 hours.

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
pri.yom@redwood.com
(Attachment: voucher_certificate_request.txt)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <pri.yom@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Nora Patel <nora@orchidai.co>
Date: 2026-07-15T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to convert accelerator voucher to prepaid invoice

Thanks — looping in finance ops. Nora, quick background from our side: vouchers issued as part of accelerator programs are normally promotional credits recorded as contra-revenue (hosted API) and aren't classified as a saleable prepaid product. That said, we have an exception flow for partners/customers who need a formal invoice for accounting.

Options we can offer (pick one):
- Option A (fastest): Generate a prepaid invoice at full voucher face value ($15,000) and mark it as "prepaid hosted credits". No split to Dedicated.
- Option B (one-off exception): Convert voucher to a prepaid invoice with a negotiated promotional concession (we can offer an operational conversion discount of up to 10–15% to cover internal reconciliation), and then apply an 80/20 split (hosted:dediacted) on the credit ledger for your onboarding — but Dedicated split requires a signed SOW and accounting review; it will be treated as a one-off and may take up to 7–10 business days.

If you can provide: billing name, address, PO number, and signed SOW, we can issue a draft invoice. For Option B we'll need an explicit approval from Orchid finance confirming acceptance of the discount and the split.

Ben Carter
Head of Partner & Program Ops, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
(Attachment: internal_policy_voucher_conversions.pdf stub)

From: Mira Chen <mira.finance@orchidai.co>
To: Priyom Das <pri.yom@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-16T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to convert accelerator voucher to prepaid invoice

Hi all — thanks for the clarity. Orchid finance (I'm Mira) approves Option B if Redwood can do a 10% conversion concession and provide a line-itemed invoice that shows $15,000 voucher value, $1,500 concession, and net prepaid amount. We also confirm acceptance of an 80/20 hosted:reserved split for credit application as long as the reserved portion is labeled as a "committed credit hold" and not an amortized capital asset.

Billing details:
Orchid AI Inc.
PO: OA-2026-5321
Address: 210 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94103
Contact for PO: Mira Chen, mira.finance@orchidai.co

Attached is our signed SOW (SOW_OrchidAI_signed.pdf). Please generate the invoice so we can route to accounts payable.

Thanks —
Mira Chen
Head of Finance, Orchid AI
(Attachment: SOW_OrchidAI_signed.pdf)

From: Priyom Das <pri.yom@redwood.com>
To: Nora Patel <nora@orchidai.co>, Mira Chen <mira.finance@orchidai.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-20T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to convert accelerator voucher to prepaid invoice

Mira / Nora — thanks, and appreciate the quick turnaround. Finance has approved Option B with the 10% conversion concession you requested. We will:

- Issue an invoice showing: voucher face $15,000; conversion concession $1,500; net payable $13,500.
- Label credits at redemption as 80% hosted API credits and 20% reserved/committed credits ("committed credit hold") per the SOW. Note: the reserved credits will be visible in the Dedicated console only after onboarding and are governed by the Dedicated SLA in the SOW.
- Generate Invoice_8347.pdf and send a payment link / wire instructions in a separate email to Mira and AP.

Lauren will coordinate onboarding for the week of Aug 10 — Lauren, please reach out to Nora to confirm dates.

Deliverables attached: Invoice_8347.pdf (draft). Once payment clears we'll provision credits against your account and trigger the onboarding checklist.

Best,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: Invoice_8347.pdf)
